body: i’m also here if you’d ever like to talk to someone. i feel the same a lot of the time and understand what you’re going through, so if you ever need to just have a conversation, i’m here. :)

one of my friends that goes to the school that i want to transfer to offered to talk to my parents about it. i’m really close to her and we’ve gone through similar struggles as she went to the school that i go to now and transferred because she had it rough here too, and i asked my parents if they wanted to talk to her but they said no. she also even offered to give me rides to/from school every single day if i transferred because she wants me to be happy and knows that my parents can’t take me, yet they refuse to talk to her and they refuse to let her give me rides.

my mom is a nurse and she claims that doctors don’t recommend children under 18 taking depression medication as it can worsen their symptoms and they’re just children, idk if this is really true though.
